title: Apolonia win Kategoria I-re Meshkuj 2021/22 season
description: Apolonia have won the Kategoria I-re Meshkuj 2021/22 season beating Flamurtari 85-69 in the last game. Joseph Cortesio (198-F) stepped up with 22 points and Joshua Dennis (195-F-1998, college: Molloy) delivered 20. Demetrious Floyd (183-PG-1993, college: SF Austin) followed them with 16 points in a win. Igli Berdo (G-1996) and Felis Zinxhiria (2005) replied with 21 points each in a loss.
